name: Arabian Petroleum Ltd.
summary: Arabian Petroleum Ltd. is an Indian company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of a diverse range of lubricants and specialty oils, operating within the downstream petroleum sector. Its primary products include automotive lubricants such as engine oils, gear oils, transmission fluids, and coolants, sold under the Arzol brand. The company also produces industrial lubricants, including hydraulic oils, industrial gear oils, thermic fluids, metalworking fluids, and greases, marketed under the SPL brand. Additionally, it offers specialty oils like transformer oils, white oils, and petroleum jelly. Arabian Petroleum Ltd. serves a broad spectrum of industries including automotive, engineering, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, FMCG, chemicals, steel, and textiles. The company operates in both domestic and international markets, exporting to over 25 countries. It also acts as a certified supplier to the Indian Navy, Army, and Air Force. The company's manufacturing facility is located in Ambernath, Maharashtra, with a production capacity of approximately 40,000 kiloliters per annum for lubricants and other specialty products. Arabian Petroleum Ltd. employs an integrated model for manufacturing and distribution, specializing in customizing lubricants for various industrial applications.
